_comment: Vendor-specific function -> LTspice/ngspice-common form. 'rename' changes the call name; 'template' expands with $0,$1,... argument placeholders (each wrapped in parentheses before re-parsing, so precedence is preserved). Functions not listed here pass through unchanged. Add a vendor function by adding one entry here -- no code change.

pwrs.why: PSpice PWRS(x,y) is signed power sgn(x)*|x|^y (PSpice/OrCAD A/D Reference). NOTE: ngspice's psa compat mode computes pwrs() with the OPPOSITE sign for negative x, so `smeister validate` can report a spurious FAIL on PWRS models with negative arguments — the translation here follows the authoritative PSpice definition, not ngspice's emulation.

pwr.why: PSpice PWR(x,y) is |x|^y (PSpice/OrCAD A/D Reference). NOTE: ngspice's psa compat mode computes pwr() as signed pow(x,y) for negative x, so validation against psa can spuriously diverge; the translation follows the authoritative PSpice definition.

stp.why: PSpice STP(x) unit step == ngspice/LTspice u(x)

limit.why: PSpice/LTspice LIMIT(x,lo,hi) clamp -> max/min, which is unambiguous in every ngspice mode (bare-ngspice limit() is not a 3-arg clamp) and in LTspice

if.why: native ngspice B-sources reject if() ('no such function if'); the ?: ternary is equivalent and valid in native AND ltpsa ngspice. The LTspice profile keeps if(), which LTspice supports and which verifies under ngspice ltpsa.
